Subtype/Stage: women with early stage breast cancer
Eligibility Summary: Women aged 18+ with completely resected, node-negative, invasive HER2-positive breast cancer ≤3 cm, within 84 days of qualifying surgery, with ECOG 0–1, adequate organ function, and LVEF ≥50%. Key exclusions included pregnancy or breastfeeding, locally advanced disease, chemotherapy within the past 5 years, prior trastuzumab, active infection or cardiac disease, and grade ≥2 neuropathy.

Subtype/Stage: Omeprazole plus neoadjuvant chemotherapy for triple-negative breast cancer.
Eligibility Summary: Newly diagnosed stage I–III triple-negative breast cancer. Stage I tumors had to be T1c.

Subtype/Stage: Metastatic triple-negative breast cancer
Eligibility Summary: Adults with metastatic triple-negative breast cancer and 0–2 prior lines of systemic therapy for metastatic disease.

Subtype/Stage: Letrozole with or without bevacizumab before surgery
Eligibility Summary: Postmenopausal women with newly diagnosed, measurable, hormone receptor–positive, HER2-negative, nonmetastatic invasive breast cancer. No prior chemotherapy.

Subtype/Stage: P10s-PADRE vaccine with neoadjuvant chemotherapy
Eligibility Summary: Patients with clinical stage I–III, ER-positive, HER2-negative breast cancer receiving chemotherapy before surgery.

Subtype/Stage: Bicalutamide with or without metformin (BIMET-1)
Eligibility Summary: Men without diabetes and with biochemically recurrent prostate cancer after prior definitive treatment, BMI >25, normal testosterone, and a PSA doubling time of 3–9 month

Subtype/Stage: Stereotactic body radiation therapy for early-stage prostate cancer
Eligibility Summary: Newly diagnosed, localized prostate cancer, generally stage T2a or lower and Gleason ≤6. Select low-volume Gleason 3+4 tumors were eligible. Prior prostate surgery or radiotherapy excluded.

Subtype/Stage: Abiraterone and prednisone with discontinuation of GnRH injections
Eligibility Summary: Men with metastatic prostate cancer receiving abiraterone and prednisone.

Subtype/Stage: CyberKnife stereotactic radiation
Eligibility Summary: Men with organ-confined, low- or intermediate-risk prostate cancer.

Subtype/Stage: Azacitidine plus all-trans retinoic acid
Eligibility Summary: Men with PSA-only recurrence after local treatment for prostate cancer.

Subtype/Stage: Cabozantinib with docetaxel and prednisone
Eligibility Summary: Men aged 18+ with progressive metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer and no prior chemotherapy for that stage.

Subtype/Stage: Type 1 diabetes during pregnancy
Eligibility Summary: Pregnant women aged 18+ with pre-existing type 1 diabetes using an insulin pump and receiving delivery care at UMass Memorial Medical Center.

Subtype/Stage: Type 2 diabetes
Eligibility Summary: Adults aged 18+ with type 2 diabetes, HbA1c 6.5–9.0%, BMI ≥25, and a stable GLP-1 receptor agonist dose for ≥3 months.

Subtype/Stage: Type 2 diabetes
Eligibility Summary: Insulin-naive adults aged 18+ with type 2 diabetes for ≥6 months and HbA1c 9–13% despite at least two oral diabetes medications, with or without a GLP-1 receptor agonist.

Subtype/Stage: Durability of Combination Therapy for type 2 diabetes
Eligibility Summary: Patients with newly diagnosed type 2 diabetes

Subtype/Stage: Comparing behavioral programs for adults with type 1 diabetes
Eligibility Summary: Adults with type 1 diabetes

Subtype/Stage: Comparing standard of care loop diuretics in heart failure patients
Eligibility Summary: Adults aged 18+ with heart failure, a stable diuretic dose for ≥30 days, and an expected need for long-term oral loop diuretics.

Subtype/Stage: Subcutaneous furosemide using the Furoscix Infusor
Eligibility Summary: Adults aged 18–80 with worsening NYHA class II–III heart failure, fluid overload, and existing oral loop-diuretic treatment, suitable for outpatient management.

Subtype/Stage: Heart failure with preserved ejection fraction
Eligibility Summary: Adults with symptomatic heart failure, EF ≥50%, and evidence supporting HFpEF, able to participate in exercise training.

Subtype/Stage: Dapagliflozin at Discharge on Hospital Heart Failure Readmission
Eligibility Summary: Adults 18–90 discharged after acute HF hospitalization; NYHA II–IV; with or without type 2 diabetes. Excludes type 1 diabetes, severe kidney impairment, and pregnancy/breastfeeding.

Subtype/Stage: Dapagliflozin in preserved ejection fraction; study threshold EF ≥45%
Eligibility Summary: Symptomatic HF with EF ≥45%, elevated natriuretic peptides, and stable HF/diuretic treatment. Excludes recent HF hospitalization, type 1 diabetes, severe kidney impairment, and pregnancy/breastfeeding.
